title: A Name
text: "Everyone here has a name except the one who keeps us. That's been bothering me for four years."

lines.text: "Warden. It's old. It means someone who watches over a thing that isn't theirs."
"I thought about other ones. This one fits. You don't have to like it."

choices.label: Accept the name
choices.reply: "Warden, then." {first} says it twice, to hear how it sounds, and goes back to work smiling.

choices.label: "I'd rather not be named."
choices.reply: "All right." {first} doesn't argue, and doesn't use it. Some of the others do anyway.
